name: phalanx-engine
description: A game-agnostic deterministic lockstep multiplayer engine with authentication, matchmaking, and command synchronization

scripts.heroku-postbuild: corepack enable && corepack prepare pnpm@10.33.0 --activate && pnpm install && pnpm --filter phalanx-math build && pnpm --filter phalanx-server build && pnpm --filter game-test-server build
scripts.render-build:chapaev-client: corepack enable && corepack prepare pnpm@10.33.0 --activate && pnpm install && pnpm --filter chapaev... build
scripts.render-build:chapaev-server: corepack enable && corepack prepare pnpm@10.33.0 --activate && pnpm install && pnpm --filter chapaev-server... build
scripts.render-build:chapaev: corepack enable && corepack prepare pnpm@10.33.0 --activate && pnpm install && pnpm --filter chapaev... --filter chapaev-server... build
